item.front: What gets pulled apart in anaphase I?

evidence.quote: Anaphase I separates homologous pairs; anaphase II separates sister chromatids.

item.front: What gets pulled apart in anaphase II?

evidence.quote: Anaphase I separates homologous pairs; anaphase II separates sister chromatids.

item.front: What happens to the sister chromatids in anaphase?
item.back: They get pulled apart to opposite poles.

evidence.quote: This one will be on the midterm, by the way: anaphase is where the sister chromatids get pulled apart.
